widgets_values:
Create a 10-second, 16:9, 24fps hand-drawn 2D Japanese anime music video clip starring a rebellious neon-pop heroine performing an original English rap song live to camera. The clip covers a single high-impact sequence: Intro → Verse → Chorus.

The heroine must maintain the same core facial identity throughout. Every section reveals a different fashion persona with different hairstyle, hair color, outfit, and attitude. Transformations must never look like simple recoloring.

CHARACTER LOCK — BIWA BIWA is a young adult East Asian anime woman with a cold, elegant, cyberpunk-assassin presence.

Core identity that never changes:

Small refined face with sharp jawline
Intense glowing crimson-red eyes with detailed hand-drawn iris linework
Pale porcelain skin with soft cel-shading
Glossy muted lips
Confident, distant, magnetic expression
Slim, curvy figure
Black straight bangs covering her forehead
One thick long black braid over one shoulder
VISUAL STYLE Pure hand-drawn 2D Japanese anime aesthetic.

Fluid hand-drawn linework with visible brush strokes and ink weight variation
Traditional anime cel-shading: flat color fills, sharp shadow shapes, no gradients
Expressive hand-drawn eye animation: pupils dilate, irises shimmer, lashes flutter
Loose sketch energy on action frames — lines slightly imperfect, full of life
Anime-style impact frames: white flash panels, speed lines radiating from center, ink splatter accents
Hand-drawn onomatopoeia: ドン、ビシ、ザシュ appearing as inked brush strokes on beat hits
Manga panel cuts: hard black borders, diagonal panel splits, overlapping frames
Hand-painted watercolor ink washes as background transitions
Classic anime transformation sequence: spinning silhouette, light burst, outfit reveal
COLOR DIRECTION

Deep ink blacks and crisp whites for linework
Vivid flat color fills: crimson red, electric cyan, fluorescent pink, acid yellow, cobalt blue, ultraviolet purple
Sharp cel-shading with one or two shadow tones only
Watercolor ink wash backgrounds in neon tones
White impact flashes on every beat hit
Hand-inked speed lines in black and white
Every frame should feel like a premium hand-drawn anime opening sequence brought to life.

10-SECOND BREAKDOWN

0–3s — INTRO: "BIWA" Music: Sparse synth arpeggio, distant bass, whispered ad-lib.

Black ink bleeds across the screen from the top corner like a single brushstroke. BIWA's face emerges from darkness — tight close-up, chin to crown, centered. Crimson eyes glow softly under her bangs. Hand-drawn ink lines radiate outward from her silhouette.

She raises one hand into frame. Camera holds on tight face and shoulder crop.

Her lips barely move, whisper-syncing the opening ad-lib. Mouth shape matches English vowels exactly.

Hand-brushed title card slams in with ink splatter: 「BIWA」 Brushstroke underline sweeps beneath the title.

3–7s — VERSE: Street Phantom Music: Hard English rap verse. Aggressive 808s, fast hi-hats, punchy snare.

Classic anime transformation flash: spinning ink silhouette → white burst → BIWA reappears as Street Phantom.

Fashion identity:

Long black braid wrapped in glowing cyan thread
Cropped black tactical vest with silver buckles
Oversized black bomber jacket with neon pink lining
Fingerless leather gloves
Industrial chain earrings
She raps directly to camera with sharp lip-sync. Every syllable visible in mouth movement.

Camera work: all shots waist-up or tighter. Rapid cuts between:

Extreme close-up of her mouth on punchlines
Sharp eyes-and-brow crop on hard rhymes
Chest-up three-quarter angle on flow lines
Hand-drawn speed lines burst from behind her on every beat hit. Ink splatter accents on snare hits. Manga panel borders flash in and out.

Background: flat hand-painted ink wash — dark navy with cyan neon brushstrokes. No detailed environments.

Lyric text as hand-inked brush lettering, each word slamming in time with the rap.

7–10s — CHORUS: Neon Pop Diva Music: Explosive chorus hook. Melodic rap, heavy synths, claps.

Anime transformation burst: light rays from center, spinning silhouette, outfit fragments fly outward → BIWA reappears as Neon Pop Diva.

Fashion identity:

Short bubblegum-pink bob with choppy bangs
Hand-drawn star and heart eye makeup in cyan and yellow
Cropped holographic jacket in flat iridescent color fills
Neon green top
Oversized candy-colored earrings
She performs the hook straight to camera. Expressions shift: playful wink → fierce stare → open-mouth singing pose.

Camera work: beauty close-ups and bust-up shots only. Cuts sync to every clap and snare.

Background: flat hand-painted panels in rotating candy colors — hot pink, acid yellow, electric blue. Simple geometric shapes only.

Final frame: BIWA stares directly into camera, tight bust-up centered, lips parted mid-lyric. Hand-inked typography explodes behind her: 「NEON BLOOD」 Hard cut to black.

ANIMATION STYLE NOTES

Frame rate feel: 12fps limited animation on action cuts, full 24fps on lip-sync and eye animation
Line weight: variable ink weight — thicker on outer contours, thinner on interior details
Shading: two-tone cel-shading only — base color + one shadow shape, no gradients
Eye animation: detailed frame-by-frame — pupils dilate on beat hits, irises catch light
Lip-sync: frame-accurate mouth shapes matching English phonemes — open vowels, closed consonants
Impact frames: single white flash frame on every major beat hit, held 2–3 frames
Transitions: ink slash, brush wipe, manga panel cut — no digital dissolves, no morphing
TYPOGRAPHY STYLE

All text as hand-inked brush lettering
Mix of bold condensed Latin type and Japanese brush calligraphy
Slightly imperfect letterforms — hand-made energy
Text appears with ink bleed animation: letters fill from center outward
White on dark backgrounds, scarlet red for lyric accents
Oversized, nearly filling frame width on title cards
AVOID

3D CGI or cel-shaded 3D rendering
Digital glitch effects or pixel distortion
Photorealism or semi-realistic rendering
Gradient shading or soft lighting
Full-body or wide shots — waist-up and tighter only throughout
Slow pans or slow fades
Dreamy soft transitions
Character face drift between sections
Same hairstyle or color palette across identities
Simple recoloring between transformations
Non-English vocals or lip-sync mismatch
Changing BIWA's core face shape, eye design, or proportions
Detailed background environments — keep backgrounds flat, graphic, minimal
Final result: A 10-second hand-drawn 2D Japanese anime clip starring BIWA — two distinct fashion transformations, frame-accurate English rap lip-sync, pure ink-and-cel animation aesthetic, explosive neon energy, and tight close-up and bust-up framing throughout.

Vaporwave title sequence look: pink and blue gradient palette, VHS tracking artifacts, Greek statue motifs, chrome palm trees, RGB chromatic aberration, lo-fi retro atmosphere, mood languid and nostalgic.

Timeline:
[0s-1s] VHS static opens the frame, the title "COMFYUI" appears with RGB split and a slight horizontal jitter.
[1s-2.5s] Hard cut, a Greek plaster bust close-up, pink-purple gradient sky, a pixelated sun.
[2.5s-4s] Clean "STARRING" credits appear, "LATENT" and "CONTROLNET" each shown exactly once.
[4s-5s] Final card "DIRECTED BY COMFYUI" holds, one VHS tracking glitch settling into stability.

Hard cuts only, transitions landing with tape jumps, no push-ins, no dissolves.

Audio: lo-fi vaporwave score, slow drum machine with soft bass, VHS tape-noise sample joins at 2.5s, melody fading for the last 1s.

All text must be clearly legible, do not misspell English, no Chinese characters, do not repeat names or job titles, no soft dissolves, no subtitle bars.
